newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU finance ministers reach budget, jobs deal.
newsitem.headline: EU finance ministers reach budget, jobs deal.

text.p: European Union finance ministers reached agreement on Monday on a budget stability pact for countries joining a single currency and a resolution on jobs and growth, Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm said.

"We have reached complete agreement on the stability pact and the resolution for growth and employment," he told reporters after finance ministers met at an EU summit to resolve differences between France and the 14 other member states.
Zalm declined to give contents of the agreement, which finance ministers were due to report to EU leaders when their summit session resumes at 1300 GMT.

But EU monetary affairs commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy told reporters the accord provided for a special lending programme by the European Investment Bank to help small businesses and high-technology companies.
He said there the European Union would hold a special summit on jobs later this year.

He said there would be a link between an EU pact limiting budget deficits of countries which join a single European currency and the pact on growth and employment, as France's new Socialist-led government had sought.
